page.layout: One column of verse, set in italic lines, with indented and flush lines. No margin notes. Printed page number at the head, catchword at the lower right.

p.i: Nec capi dextra sinit hunc cruenta,
Vrgeant si te mala multa, spera,
Hanc in æternum tua stirps tenebit.
At quibus nec ius pietasq; cordi est,

page.notes: The catchword "Nam" is set in long s form; its last letter is uncertain and is given as [?]. The word "&" in "Iustus, & ueri" is a printed ampersand form. The printed "quoq;" and "pœnas" are kept as printed. A small stray mark at the left edge was left out as not printed text.
